title: Projection norm and Fourier weight
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function and let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The squared uniform norm of its projection onto the coordinates in $J$ equals $1$ minus the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ indexed by subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ that are not contained in $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a set of coordinates in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
